codex.problem:
Two hand-derived fixture claims are false. (1) control_flow.comments says "Rz(2*pi) = -I on t" and "H p; controlled_phase; H p therefore produces p=1 with probability one", but @phase actually uses the finite binary64 literal theta=6.283185307179586=884279719003555/140737488355328, not 2*pi. For t=p=0 the exact final amplitudes in wire order (t,p) are (1+exp(-i*theta/2))/2 on 00 and (1-exp(-i*theta/2))/2 on 01. Thus P(p=0)=cos(theta/4)^2, approximately 3.749399456654644e-33, is strictly positive. An independently pinned two-function wrapper with body "action @probe (t:wire mut, p:wire mut) () () () ()
^entry():
h p
ctl p action_call @phase (t) () () ()
h p
" reproduces state {"00":[0,-6.12323823339278e-17],"01":[1,6.12323823339278e-17]}, mut:[0,null], not the claimed single basis outcome. Original @phase hash eb4b8c89a878e6fb8c514214417d0827f809fe0fd6b155e2f395ec19f5f31271, wrapper hash 0655c9e45f09d1748fbf0241e6d38244e7f353153a3f365f0a5f712b37a6e24d, object hash 04baeadb96dbafb2dc94832982272b6cfeb60174de6c8bb407bd28a3e4c37294.
